# `vendor/` — the two files this repo does not own

Copied verbatim from the ddd repository. Nothing here is edited locally; if a
file needs to change, it changes there and is re-copied.

| File | Upstream | Refresh with |
|---|---|---|
| `kernel.d.ts` | `web/kernel-api/dist/kernel.d.ts` (generated by `npm run kernel:dts`, served at `/kernel.d.ts`) | `cp …/ddd/web/kernel-api/dist/kernel.d.ts vendor/` |
| `vite.plugin-config.mjs` | `plugins/base/_shared/vite.plugin-config.mjs` | `cp …/ddd/plugins/base/_shared/vite.plugin-config.mjs vendor/` |

**Why vendored rather than depended on.** `kernel.d.ts` *is* the plugin contract (SPEC
§6.4) and a third-party author has exactly that one generated file — so compiling against
a checked-in copy is not a shortcut, it is the situation being reproduced. Vendoring also
pins it: a plugin here is known to have been built against a stated contract version
rather than against whatever the machine happened to have.

The Vite config is vendored for the same reason and with upstream's blessing — its own
header says "a third-party plugin can use it verbatim". Using the same builder is what
makes the output indistinguishable from a base plugin's, which is the property the server
relies on.

Both are checked by `npm run ci:test -- <id>`: a contract this repo's plugins no longer
compile against fails there.

**Contract version: 1.1.0** — bump the note when you refresh it.
